modules.name: spi_slave_regs
modules.description: Single-module SPI slave (Mode 0, 16-bit frames) with synchroniser chain, edge detection, register map (ID/VERSION/CTRL/SCRATCH0-3), MSB-first MISO/MOSI handling, and done flag logic; all in one flat Verilog-2005/2012 module.

ports.name: sclk
ports.description: SPI serial clock from master, sampled input only

ports.name: cs_n
ports.description: SPI chip select, active low, sampled input

ports.name: mosi
ports.description: SPI serial data in, MSB-first, sampled on rising sclk

ports.name: miso
ports.description: SPI serial data out, MSB-first, updated on falling sclk; 0 when cs_n high

ports.name: done
ports.description: Level signal asserted on 16th sclk rising edge of a well-formed frame

rationale: The spec mandates a single flat Verilog-2005/2012 module with no sub-modules, no functions, no RAM arrays, and no part-selects on expressions. All logic — 3-stage synchronisers for sclk/cs_n/mosi, edge detection, frame-active flag, 4-bit bit counter, byte-phase register, command shift register, data shift register, read mux (combinational always @* with case), write enables (explicit case on address), CTRL and SCRATCH0-3 registers, MISO output register, and done flag — is implemented inside the single module spi_slave_regs. The dependency list is therefore empty.
